A rectangle is inscribed in a circle with a diameter
lying along the line 3y = x + 7. If the two adjacent
vertices of the rectangle are (–8, 5) and (6, 5), then
the area of the rectangle (in sq. units) is :
en.explanation:
Distance beetween point A and B is = 14 unit

As y coordinate of point A(-8, 5) and B(6, 5) are same. So line AB is parallel to the x axis.

Point O is the center of the circle and OP is the perpendicular to the line AB. And P is the mis point of line AB.

Point P = = (-1, 5)

As OP is perpendicular to the line AB and AB is parallel to the x axis then OP is parallel to the y axis. So x coordinate of line OP is constant.

x coordinate of O = -1

And point O is lies on the line 3y = x + 7

3y = -1 + 7

y = 2

Center O = (-1, 2)

OP = 3

Then BC = 2OP = 6

Area of rectangle = (AB)(BC)

= 14 6

= 84
